notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Here's a small update for the auto battler and tower defense game modes!

[h1]Auto Battler[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a match won counter for units.
[*]Can now right click units to open unit panel.
[*]Added new quests in the teleport bulletin board. (requires new game to refill)
[*]Added Greedy Cat Effigy, an NPC that can turn monsters into gold depending on matches won and current level of the monster. (requires new game to spawn this NPC)
[*]Can now view innate abilities and immunities when inspecting a unit. (slimes splitting and etc...)
[*]Now indicates whether unit can move when inspecting it.
[/list]

[h1]Tower Defense[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now shows a hoverable popup of the selected unit when choosing a reward.
[*]Moving to outposts now closes the overworld automatically.
[*]Removed mushrooms as a basic reward.
[*]Divine Form now lasts longer.
[*]Divine Form now provides bonus cast range.
[*]Divine Form improved stats.
[*]Now auto picks up loot.
[*]Removed pick up all loot command.
[/list]

[i]Greedy Cat Effigy[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/8eee9b22ce2d2b27781973377e49616fab9c03c6.png[/img]

A couple of bug fixes as well, have a good day!

notes.title: The Book of Yohanne
notes.content:
[h1]Synopsis[/h1]
You play as Yohanne who wields the light and who is on a mission to defeat Dark Incarnate. Crusade through Grandura, fight corrupted armies and reach the Unholy Sanctum where the evil foe resides. 

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
You are an active unit in the battlefield, you can move, use abilities and items, place units, withdraw units and observe the state of the map all while the stopping the enemy. Maps get harder and more hectic as you progress, requiring more focus, speed and precision.
[previewyoutube=qo0MuvQ1B5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The Overworld[/h1]
Unlock maps as you go and choose your path to the Unholy Sanctum. If you wish, you can always go back to maps you haven't cleared yet and take a different route to discover more stuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/b91a52c3de4724678ec440e7e6c0f5a9e3a3ee05.png[/img]

[h1]Progression[/h1]
When you clear a map you get experience and gold, If clearing for the first time, you get to choose an item and unit reward and unlock connecting maps if there are any.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/89309dbe7ba7d6b27215ae255eb6b47f9ade6d47.png[/img]

[h1]Outposts[/h1]
Outposts are locations that will help you in your crusade. Each outpost is unique, providing different items and creatures to sell and units to recruit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/c75f9f46b07a4ebfb37ab3e5024650a6cb2b2c68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/304828e7d277d009642a1917cd46ee2afbf24ff7.png[/img]

[h1]Light Shards[/h1]
Light shards lets you choose an ability when clearing a map that has it. These abilities are only available when you are in your divine form which you can call upon with the Divine Form ability which is always at your disposal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/e3bf32c83f6c2dd71808efa4a327e1604d11e586.png[/img]
You start with two unique divine abilities and get to choose from the ones below when finding a light shard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/2220d0c65a4f4adfa59882859871a49e60394982.png[/img]

[h1]Unit Management[/h1]
There is leveling and experience is gained when clearing maps. Units also level up and you get to choose which ability or stat to upgrade. You can also give them items and choose who to prioritize when using their abilities/items. Maps have different maximum active units allowed but you can always withdraw/place a unit anytime.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/710f43245316f3b6b7025bcf8a8f8d9d2535dd01.png[/img]
In addition to most units from other game modes, there are new units with new abilities added for the tower defense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/2c1f87f1c016af9fa20ee96feb235668a1d3721d.png[/img]

I also did many improvements in other parts of the game as well but they weren't really relevant for this post.
Since all the game modes are availabe now, it's time to wrap this game up. In the coming days, I'll be doing story stuff, lore and art work and make improvements here and there and hopefully transition to a full release.
Thank you very much and have a nice day! Please report bugs if you have the time!

notes.title: Books of Grandura
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I haven't posted an update in a while well because I was working on a big update! First of all the game is no longer called Morphus, it is now called Books of Grandura. I have updated the store page with the new game name and new assets but the name Morphus still appears in other places and I don't know what to do about that, but that's not important!

I did not expect a really big change myself but I decided to stick with it. So Books of Grandura will have three game modes, a traditional roguelike(Morphus), an auto battler and a tower defense.

So here is the summary of the update:

[h2]The Book of Murak(Available Now)[/h2]
An auto battler set in the desert city of Suksamad. Build your team of monsters, choose which stat and ability to upgrade as they level and equip them items found in the rich market of the city. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/c62c0a5570e203aaca26ba14ce86643f94a162df.png[/img]

[h2]The Book of Morphus(Available Now)[/h2]
A traditional roguelike that provides tactical turn-based combat. Do quests, craft, take in a pet, level up, explore dense forests, caves and ruins as a polymorphic creature with the risk of permadeath.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/2f486c1e7c29f2ca0f8d268f7e4fc00c654ec074.png[/img]

[h2]The Book of Yohanne[/h2]
This will be a tower defense. Nothing much to see here yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/55e04dc6e82ab0d5b7f7e6f445b041e7b69de85b.png[/img]

I updated the main build and the demo build but you would have to reinstall the game because it's using different paths! Sorry for the inconvenience!

For now, I will be focusing on the tower defense mode and get it ready for you guys to play!
Have a nice day everybody and please report the bugs!

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Hello! I managed to get some stuff done right after the Sporeland update. Here is the summary :

[h1]Rusty Shovel[/h1]
Rusty Shovel can now be crafted and has been reworked. Depending on the area, Rusty Shovel can dig up various random items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/22b40e58e0301e49ee652e07379422bb4e20e5c7.png[/img]

[h1]New Forageables[/h1]
Added Truffle, Hard Nut and Ghost Fungus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/40a3fbc934519414fc1f15254bec83c0f31d5674.png[/img]

[h1]Basic Recipes[/h1]
Hidden before, the Crafting Furnace now has a visible list of basic items you can craft. I plan to add more items but for now you have these.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/4da42b03422ed182b3f692bc6aaf606686fca6e5.png[/img]

[h1]Reworked Affinity System[/h1]
Overview of the rework. NPCs now :
[list]
[*]Avoid entities that they have low affinity with.
[*]Forbid entities they have low affinity with from entering the shop(if NPC is a shopkeeper).
[*]Look for a guard to report to(theft or murder).
[*]Initiate battle with the player if affinity is low.
[*]Keep track of their affinity with units per appearance. So different entities, as long as they look the same will have the same affinity with a NPC.
[/list]
There are details I did not mention about the affinity system but I'll leave them for you to discover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/f74b439d83f1881b52d1c69ef0a47cafc83d7e7a.png[/img]

[h1]Dungeon[/h1]
Added a new area connected to the Town with a new Rat monster along with it. The Dungeon is where criminals are teleported when caught by guards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/cd673ed7aee13e45ff6a8cf6430cb4158ef8b159.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/13ef6259ac17ce3a7260d7c31de9e9c15f240599.png[/img]

Thank you for reading. I'll try to push an update by the end of December.

notes.title: Sporeland
notes.content:
[h1]Sporeland[/h1]
Hello! I was working on an update! Various bug fixes, reworked how special projectiles move and added a new mushroom themed area with new monsters, abilities and objects.

Here's how it looks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/76a7deecc0a11c853b833a8a117b8fbd1e5efce7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/1fd127058284fa3fd4814a157c029ddc453dcadb.png[/img]

New monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/d26a833a900a80c105206765de5cf61f8f33886a.png[/img]

New game objects as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/d0aea5ecab8e13989665ca646e38dc8bacc2b09b.png[/img]

[h1]Innate Abilities[/h1]
Added innate abilities. These are abilities that trigger when attacked, on death or every turn. Some of these abilities can only be found on a specific unit. Slimes splitting into smaller slimes when killed is a good example of an on death innate ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/1baa9fe2e3ec9e2b255e4efa058df63787b2d804.png[/img]

With the addition of innate abilities that happen every turn, projectiles that stop moving until the floor's turn now also move at the start of each battling unit's turn. This makes it more consistent and battles end faster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/366c706143317b67d023ea44a2c5304ffeea07fe.jpg[/img]

Thank you have a nice day!

notes.title: NPC Galore
notes.content:
Hello there! I was working on an update for about a month and half. Here's what I worked on. Keep in mind that these updates are subject to change and are not final.

[h1]Town NPCS[/h1]
Aside from the shop owners, the town also now has townsfolk. These npcs may have special dialogue when you interact with them. They may give you gold, items, information, lore and etc. Some may also have unique abilities!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/9e17968313d81c35496c05a6ac5e4d9aab4597f1.png[/img]

[h1]Out-of-Town NPCS[/h1]
There are also special npcs that you encounter as you progress through the world. These npcs are random. They may give quests, they may sell items, depending on your luck they may be a fairy, a witch or a scammer in disguise and etc.
[i]An example of a special npc that challenges you to a riddle match.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/910ff25e513e103652c58d1be898244ef0910ff7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/6f1ed70068bc11c5038f0f4cc615275afad51fd7.png[/img]

[h1]Attackable NPCS[/h1]
All npcs are now attackable. Whenever you attack an npc, your affinity with them decreases which results to bad consequences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/b40fb3c2c38e4f009db48d0810c480fb294b017c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stealing[/h1]
If you're feeling lucky, you can also try to steal from these npcs. Steal success chance is affected by the Vision stat of the one trying to steal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/14e8d2ff81610e873aae5beadcc6651805e6af3c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/bba2c47be4e17d248a38f134f568ace4576d02e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Outlaw Guards[/h1]
Outlaw Guards added. Whenever you kill an npc or caught stealing, the guards in the area are alerted and they become your enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/e988017ad6e5e6c94e409e18b2c75dea9e3eebcf.png[/img]

[h1]Affinity Quests[/h1]
I also added affinity quests. These are quests that give affinity for a certain character as part of the reward. They are only found through shop keepers for now but that's going to change in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/00c0fb52d79df819cde0961961762045cd84814e.png[/img]

There are also things that I did not add here because they didn't seem major.
That's it for the update! Thank you for the read and have a nice day!
